courses.title: Applied Machine Learning for Analysts
courses.description: Applied Machine Learning for Analysts takes you from the basics of applied machine learning to applying it on a realistic People Manager scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to statistical programming, enough to use it alongside applied machine learning day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying applied machine learning to a real People Manager scenario

Getting a working introduction to statistical programming
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.description: Getting Started with Scientific Writing is a short introduction to scientific writing for people moving toward a People Manager role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show scientific writing in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if scientific writing is new to you.

alternates.title: Applied Machine Learning Essentials
alternates.description: Applied Machine Learning Essentials walks you through the basics of applied machine learning, built for people new to People Manager work. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
